lines.text: Many learners say: Yesterday I have seen Ana.
Saw! Last night I saw a movie.

native.tip: Con ayer, la semana pasada, etc., usa pasado simple: “I saw”, no “have seen”.
native.caption: En español “ayer he visto” suena normal, ¡en inglés no! 🎬 Di “Yesterday I saw Ana.”, no “Yesterday I have seen Ana.”. ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “saw”. Tiempo terminado, pasado simple. Practica más con un quiz gratis aquí: {link}

en.tip: With yesterday, last week, etc., use the simple past: “I saw”, not “have seen”.
en.caption: In Spanish “ayer he visto” sounds fine, but not in English! Say “Yesterday I saw Ana.”, not “Yesterday I have seen Ana.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
